title: cs-claude-turn reports a turn that Claude Code is still retrying as stalled
foundBy: user question (host): "you have to test this across all three agent's right?", answered by running all three turn drivers against an injected 429
details:
Claude Code 2.1.258 has its own retry, and with its defaults it tries a `429` ten times. It waits the provider's `Retry-After` and then longer, about 3 minutes 40 seconds in all. While it waits, the pane reads `429 … · Retrying in 14s · attempt 10/10`, the session file does not grow, and the words `esc to interrupt` are absent. `cs-claude-turn` reads that pane as `ready`. Its stall watchdog then ends the turn after 180 seconds with exit 2 and `turn stalled`.

Measured on a sandbox with a lent key and `cs-sandbox lender fault --status 429 --retry-after 12`. The exit status of the driver was 2, at 181 seconds. Claude Code wrote its flagged error message and the `turn_duration` marker at 218 seconds, to a driver that had gone.

A caller is told that a throttled member stalled, while the member is still working in its TUI. A fleet harness answers a stall with a restart, which re-sends the whole context into the limit. That is the outcome SBX-044 and SBX-051 were filed to prevent. The fix for SBX-051 was verified with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=2`, which ends before the watchdog, so it did not meet this.

`cs-codex-turn` is not affected, because codex shows `esc to interrupt` while it reconnects. `cs-opencode-turn` waits on the client's exit and has no such watchdog. Under the same fault it exited 5 after 64 seconds and 9 requests.
